description: Make Discord timestamp codes like <t:1767225600:F> that show a date and time in every reader's own time zone, for event announcements and stream schedules. Pass an ISO 8601 date-time with its UTC offset (e.g. "2026-12-31T20:00:00-05:00") or a Unix timestamp in seconds. Returns all seven formats.

time.description: ISO 8601 date-time including the UTC offset or Z, or Unix seconds. Ask the user for their time zone if it isn't known.

name: discord_timestamp
title: Discord timestamp codes
